descriptionChirho: Proper noun: Zerah (also Zerach), a masculine personal name meaning 'rising, dawning, shining forth,' borne by several individuals in the Hebrew Bible including a son of Judah and Tamar (Gen 38:30, twin of Perez), a son of Reuel and grandson of Esau (Gen 36:13,17), a son of Simeon (Num 26:13), a Levite ancestor of Ethan (1 Chr 6:21,41), and a Cushite military commander who invaded Judah (2 Chr 14:9). Translated as English 'Zerah,' Spanish 'Zeraj/Zeraj,' Hindi 'Jerah/Zerah' (जेरह/ज़ेरह), Arabic 'Zarah' (زارَح/زَرَحَ), Korean 'Sera/Jera' (세라/제라), Swahili 'Zera.' All three clusters represent the same proper name in different syntactic positions: standalone, with preposition lamed, and with conjunction waw.
